implementation_strategy: Use hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter with OpenAI-hosted gpt-5-mini via openai_responses. For each of 120 preregistered paired tasks: (1) create fresh model session; (2) issue one shared initial-generation call (shared_initial_candidate) recorded per task; (3) run deterministic Batfish ingestion/verification; (4) when verifier fails, in guarded condition issue at most one repair call using the generate_validate_repair_v1 template; (5) deterministic automated scoring via Batfish rulebook mapping. All prompts, session IDs, API headers, hashes, verifier logs, and artifacts recorded in execution manifest. No human scientific labour; no local GPU. Execution constrained to maximum_model_calls=240 and 7-day wall-clock window.
public_resources: preregistered_task_bank (pilot20 + confirmatory120) - public/sanitized topology templates and intent specs
canonicalization and rendering code (vendor-neutral templates) - archived
verifier mapping rulebook (failure-type -> localized-feedback template) - frozen
task_manifest_strategy: Use the preregistered confirmatory 120-task manifest. Each task paired (baseline vs guarded). Canonicalization and Batfish-ingest smoke tests applied pre-invocation; tasks failing canonicalization are deterministically excluded and logged.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline uses direct_configuration_generation_v1 template; Guarded uses generate_validate_repair_v1 which includes deterministic mapping from Batfish failures to localized-feedback fields per frozen rulebook. Templates frozen in preregistration.
execution_batches: batch-1: tasks 1-120 processed as paired trials; per-pair execution order randomized with fixed seed; single-run orchestration to respect maximum_model_calls
randomisation_plan: Within each pair, execution order (which condition first) randomized using PRNG seed=42. Pair processing order randomized using same seed. Randomisation seed and RNG algorithm (Mersenne Twister) recorded in manifest.
caching_plan: Cache prompt templates, canonicalization artifacts, and Batfish analysis artifacts locally; do not reuse model sessions across runs. No reuse of model-generated content across different tasks except for deterministic template resources.
failure_recovery_plan: Infrastructure/API failures: up to two automated retries per failed API call (per preregistration). If still failing, mark trial as infrastructure failure and exclude from primary confirmatory analysis per missingness_plan. Deterministic flagging rules enforce exclusion on session_id reuse or contamination. All retries, failures, and exclusions logged.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (version 1.0) — per-task record: task_id, pair_id, condition, initial_generation_call_id, repair_call_id (if any), Batfish_result (pass/fail), failure_type_codes, localized_feedback_payload, model_session_id, prompt_hash, output_hash, timestamps, wall_clock_time_ms, excluded_flag (reason code).
estimated_compute_notes: Total planned model calls = 120 tasks * up to 2 calls (one shared initial generation + at most one repair) = 240 calls. All calls via hosted OpenAI API (gpt-5-mini). No local GPU required. Wall-clock execution expected <7 days given provider rate limits and parallelism; network verification (Batfish) runs on CPU host; compute for Batfish per-call is low and fits CPU execution. All artifacts and logs archived.
